description: Pull, count, or orient over source-cited Manifests. For recurring watches prefer beacon_id with an explicit lookback, and dedupe by manifest_id. delivery_delta=true can use a stream/channel-only Beacon as scope when enabled. stream_ids, home_domains, and source_channel_ids are INTERSECTED; DERIVE source_channel_ids from details/search when unsure. 17-digit Synorb ID values: pass them as JSON strings, never a number. USE THIS WHEN: the user needs evidence/content with date/entity/topic/source filters. DO NOT USE THIS WHEN: the user only asks inventory, usage, or source availability. OUTPUT: write a briefing (reasoning-v1) from claims and supporting_quotes, not from headlines; keep each first-party link inline and end with a source index. briefing.scaffold lists the ranked items, Claims with exact figures, groups and a recipe for the opening. The server makes no model call when you read.

accept_partial_plan.description: Accept a partial mode='plan' result for default execution; never inferred.
accept_partial_plan.title: Accept Partial Plan

api_key.description: Synorb key; only if the Authorization header is not set. Tool arguments may be logged.
api_key.title: Api Key

broaden_sources.description: With beacon_id: let request scope REPLACE the Beacon's saved scope. Default false fails closed.
broaden_sources.title: Broaden Sources

checkpoint.description: Opaque signed checkpoint from a prior delta call: the checkpoint object, or its next_page_cursor/commit_cursor string. Send back whichever it gave you.
checkpoint.title: Checkpoint

compact.description: Scan tier: find items, then read in full.
compact.title: Compact

delivery_delta.description: Incremental sync over the routed-at delivery stream, paged by checkpoint. Narrower than an ordinary call: a Manifest enters it only once routed, so an authoritative zero means nothing was routed in the window, not that nothing matched. Not a substitute for an ordinary count. A stream/channel-only Beacon may scope it (beacon_id, no lookback_hours); refusals name unsupported_fields.
delivery_delta.title: Delivery Delta

exclude_query_terms.description: Best-effort: drops manifests whose headline/summary/source labels contain any term.
exclude_query_terms.title: Exclude Query Terms

include_diagnostics.description: False (default) omits the large operator/proof blocks regardless of response_profile. True includes them, e.g. to debug a coverage/absence decision. Never changes which manifests are returned or billed.
include_diagnostics.title: Include Diagnostics

lookback_hours.description: Relative date window in hours; works for one-off or Beacon execution.
lookback_hours.title: Lookback Hours

markdown_version.description: '2' adds Brief body_markdown_v2 (TL;DR, Key Facts, Why It Matters, Timeline, Unresolved).
markdown_version.title: Markdown Version

plan_token.description: Signed token from mode='plan'; binds default execution to its query and catalog generation.
plan_token.title: Plan Token

profile.description: Reader profile: role, goals, watchlist, exclusions.
profile.title: Profile

relative_to.description: Anchor relative windows to the availability ceiling or wall_clock; default is the entitlement ceiling.
relative_to.title: Relative To

required_families.description: Deprecated; use required_surfaces. If both are given they must agree after alias translation (business_podcasts -> podcasts).
required_families.title: Required Families

required_surfaces.description: Ordered surface set required by a strict balanced plan. Surfaces not plan-resolvable fail closed with surface_not_yet_queryable.
required_surfaces.title: Required Surfaces

response_profile.description: 'full' (default) or 'slim'. Slim is a scan tier: it drops source metadata and citation authority and adds a finding_aid. Never changes which Manifests are returned or billed.
response_profile.title: Response Profile

scan_cursor.description: Opaque source-mix continuation from pagination.next_scan_cursor. Not snapshot_token; totals and empty-population claims stay unknown.
scan_cursor.title: Scan Cursor

sec_cik.description: Exact SEC CIK(s); normalized to ten digits.
sec_cik.title: Sec Cik

sec_ticker.description: Exact ticker(s) stored on SEC filings. Distinct from the broader company ticker scope.
sec_ticker.title: Sec Ticker

snapshot_token.description: Opaque subject-bound continuation token returned by a prior exact synorb-manifests page.
snapshot_token.title: Snapshot Token

tag_ids.description: Tag IDs; comma string/list, combined by tag_logic.
tag_ids.title: Tag Ids

name: synorb-manifests
